method: Wikipedia country LGBTQ-rights extracts (current revision, retrieved 2026-09-28); one lookup per jurisdiction

results.fact: Marriage equality (2017); federal hate-crime offence Feb 2025; conversion-therapy bans ~85% of pop. since Oct 2024 — far beyond pre-2017 state.
Legal framework unchanged: third-gender registration option (since 2019) stands; no 2024-26 amendments or rollbacks in current sources.
No protections, hostile enforcement: mass Baku arrest waves with beatings/forced exams; strong stigma; the ILGA-2025 review picture remains current.
Same-sex acts still criminalised; Ndayishimiye's Dec-2023 'choosing Satan'/death-penalty rhetoric keeps a climate of fear.
Progressive frame intact: self-declaration gender-recognition law, conversion practices banned Jul 2023, equal marriage/adoption; no 2024-26 regression.
Adult same-sex acts legal; art.545 (2018 code) adds penalties for acts with minors; strong social hostility and lynchings; 2023 US State picture holds.
Dutch equality law applies to the public bodies; same-sex marriage performed on Bonaire/Sint Eustatius/Saba since 2018; no later change found.
New criminal code in force 1 Sep 2025 criminalises same-sex acts and 'promotion' of homosexuality (junta bill of Jul 2024) — previously legal. Sharply worse.
Section 377 ambiguity persists (life imprisonment for 'unnatural offences'); hijra third gender since 2014; five men caned Apr 2026 — enforcement continues.
Consensual same-sex conduct not criminalised (2023 US State); courts since 2023 reject gender-affirming procedures; legal gender recognition still denied.
Male acts decriminalised 1991, no recent legal change; social homophobia prominent (Dec 2018 Canadian travel advice) — still the tourist climate.
Legal state-wide (1996/98/2003); entities restrict marriage to opposite-sex couples; uneven protections, 2023 activist attack; ILGA-2024 picture stands.

evidence.title: LGBTQ rights in Bosnia and Herzegovina

results.fact: French framework applies: marriage equality, anti-discrimination law and the 2023 conversion-practice ban; local acceptance lower, no legal regression.
